temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Temperature of the water, or of the air for a terrarium.

ph.label: pH
ph.description: Acidity of the water: below 7 acid, above 7 alkaline.

gh.label: General hardness (GH)
gh.description: Calcium and magnesium content of the water.

kh.label: Carbonate hardness (KH)
kh.description: Carbonate content, which keeps the pH stable.

no2.label: Nitrite (NO₂)
no2.description: Toxic even at low levels, a sign of an incomplete nitrogen cycle.

no3.label: Nitrate (NO₃)
no3.description: End product of the nitrogen cycle, removed by water changes and plants.

nh3.label: Ammonia / ammonium (NH₃/NH₄⁺)
nh3.description: Nitrogen waste of the animals, toxic as ammonia.

po4.label: Phosphate (PO₄)
po4.description: Nutrient of algae, closely watched in reef tanks.

salinity.label: Salinity
salinity.description: Amount of dissolved salt, in parts per thousand (‰).

specific_gravity.label: Specific gravity
specific_gravity.description: Density of salt water, read with a refractometer or a hydrometer.

ca.label: Calcium (Ca)
ca.description: Used by hard corals to build their skeleton.

mg.label: Magnesium (Mg)
mg.description: Keeps calcium and KH in balance in reef tanks.

co2.label: CO₂
co2.description: Dissolved carbon dioxide, needed by plants, harmful to fish in excess.

conductivity.label: Conductivity
conductivity.description: Amount of mineral salts dissolved in the water.

illuminance.label: Illuminance
illuminance.description: Light received, measured with a lux meter.
